verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs explicitly describe an Organizations feature for representing business customers/partners and managing their membership, plus branded federated login per organization, and RBAC for role-based permissions — covering multi-tenant modeling and memberships out of the box. However, no evidence explicitly documents built-in invitation flows for organizations. missing for 10: explicit documentation of invitation-flow APIs/UI for organizations, independent/hands-on confirmation of the full org+invite workflow.
